shortDescription: Polymarket’s “Over” option in the “Houston Astros vs. Athletics” submarket for “O/U 8.5” surged from 31% one hour ago to 64%, a 33-point swing. According to ChainCatcher, the sharp move suggests the market is reacting to a sudden development affecting the event.
